summary.text: Tom Hanson is a Chicago-born small business owner who works in commercial real estate and is the Republican nominee for Illinois' 5th District, a seat he has sought in several earlier cycles.
His campaign website describes him as a "Liberal Republican – fiscally conservative/socially liberal."

paragraphs.text: Hanson was born in Chicago and lives in Illinois.
According to his campaign website, he began his career selling advertising for the Chicago Tribune and later U.S. News & World Report, and he now sells and leases commercial real estate.
He describes himself as owning a small business, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as business owner.
Hanson was the Republican nominee for this seat in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024, winning the Republican primary each year and losing each general election to Mike Quigley.
He won the Republican primary again on March 17, 2026, and is on the November 3, 2026 general-election ballot.
